neighbors.title: Role nodes carry a rung, not a model name, and one decision maps the rungs
Community Agent packs are one independent pack per discipline, three to five roles each with their handoffs inside the pack, and none of them ships an orchestrator
Every new space starts with four graph-native Agent roles, steward, researcher, curator and reviewer, and no discipline role and no orchestrator

The account backend writes the Default Agents pack into a space at its birth, first sign-in for a personal graph and creation for a team, by reading the gallery's official pack row and sending it through the existing ingest-pack proxy
A release execution document carries the package to role mapping and release-specific instructions only; the role definition stays in the node
